title: Tofu Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry dish made with crispy tofu, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of soy sauce.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.amount: 1 block, drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked tofu back into the skillet and stir in the soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the tofu is well coated with the soy sauce.
